scope: Isolated attention correctness tests on two separate physical GPUs; no model-level or performance qualification.
source_comparison: The four adaptive kernel/build files match the draft head. The tested candidate additionally includes tokenizer and health-test changes, so its full tree and binary differ from the draft.
tested_geometry: The shared-rows oracle covers head dimensions 128 and 256 with groups 1 and 8.
limits: Each GPU ran separately, not as a P2P pair.
Both segmented tests were explicitly selected despite being ignored by default.
The exact draft head, long contexts, a served A/B of adaptive dispatch, and RTX 40 and RTX 50 devices remain untested.
This correctness evidence does not establish a prefill or decode speedup.
Dispatch traces are observations of the tested candidate, not an exact-draft-tip performance measurement.
